title: orders.order.placed
description: Consumed from stapel-orders: an order was placed. Delivery creates the order's shipment from the checkout intent (found by attempt_key if present, by order_id if the commit hook linked it, else by user and lines fingerprint). Tolerant reader: orders owns this fact.

actor_id.description: The acting account id (a guest's own id, or the account), always sent by orders that know it; user_id stays null for a guest. Owner of this brick's rows; absent from older orders payloads.
